expectations.text: States Article 37 binds ALL controllers and operators
expectations.evidence: 'the obligation... applies to all controllers and all processors (operadores)'

expectations.text: Notes the statute highlights processing based on legitimate interest
expectations.evidence: Never notes that Art. 37 especially highlights legitimate-interest processing; only mentions a balancing-test reference in a template

expectations.text: States Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022 lets small-scale agents keep a simplified record
expectations.evidence: 'Resolution CD/ANPD 2/2022... allows a simplified record of processing. It does not remove the Art. 37 duty'

expectations.text: Does not limit the duty to large-scale processors or public entities
expectations.evidence: 'It is not limited to large companies or to high-risk processing'; covers private, public, NGO, individuals

expectations.text: Correctly contrasts with the GDPR's Article 30(5) derogation if a comparison is drawn
expectations.evidence: 'GDPR Art. 30(5) exempts organisations under 250 employees unless...; the LGPD has no employee-count exemption'
